newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African children die as sucked into pool filter.
newsitem.headline: S.African children die as sucked into pool filter.

text.p: Two South African children enjoying a summer swim were sucked to their deaths by a powerful pool filter, a newspaper reported on Sunday.

A witness told the Sunday Independent he saw an 11-year-old boy vanish under the surface near the powerful water recycling suction valve in a public swimming pool in the town of Mnandi. A second child was sucked down moments later.
"Shocked bystanders watched as pieces of flesh began to surface," the paper said. "It is suspected that the lid covering the suction device was removed."
The pool was drained to recover the bodies.
